name: Ogre Treasure

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Ogre Treasure
Ogres don’t keep valuables or interesting items,
but are often unaware when they swallow such
things. Characters searching a giant mound of ogre
excrement might discover something interesting if
they can stomach sifting through the stinking mess.

name: Variant Ogres

source.reason: Explicit CUR-003 source reference; edition/permission not certified.

originalText:
Variant Ogres
The trolls bred many kinds of ogres to serve various
functions in their wars against the faeries. Most of the
specialized breeds died out long ago, but a few remain
and are at large in the world today.
